title: Harmonic Cube Wave
subtitle: Isometric sinusoidal hexahedral lattice
description: Inspired by Dave Whyte (@beesandbombs). An isometric 3D matrix of precision hexahedra oscillating vertically along radial harmonic phase delays. Renders flawless isometric occlusion with back-to-front depth sorting, faceted illumination, and polyrhythmic wave dynamics.

parameters.label: Radial Frequency
parameters.description: Spatial density of outward propagating ripples

parameters.label: Grid Dimension
parameters.description: Number of cubes per isometric axis

parameters.label: Color Spectrum
parameters.description: 0: Cyber Neon, 1: Solar Amber, 2: Emerald Auroral, 3: Monochrome Noir

mathNotation: Z(x, y, t) = A \sin\left(\omega t - k \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\right)
formulaCompact: Z = A * sin(ω*t - k * hypot(x, y))
formulaFull: isoX = (gx - gy) * cos(30°), isoY = (gx + gy) * sin(30°) - A * sin(dist * k - t)
